_comment: Conformance, Conflict Alert (CA) and Mode C Intruder (MCI) thresholds (docs/adr/0058, 0118). [SOURCE-DEFINED]: our own choices, not doctrine. formationLateralNm/formationVerticalFt: how close an uncorrelated target must be to a formation flight to count as one of its members (ADR 0118, ours; P/CG gives 1 mile and 100 ft for a standard formation). refueling*: the air refueling block relative to the tanker (ADR 0118). airspaceEntry: the airspace-entry alert ignores a track slower or younger than these (ADR 0119, ours). Override by placing a copy in state/alerting.json; missing keys fall back to these. glidepath*: the PAR final's one alert (ADR 0139, H164 FT-Q8): after Begin descent and above DA, the PAR plot more than glidepathAboveDeg above or glidepathBelowDeg below the glidepath for glidepathPersistSec (the PAR panel's default tolerance lines, ADR 0123: +1 degree, and 0.5 degree below, the FAA lower safe limit; the persistence is ours). handoff: notCheckedInSec is how long a receiver may have an accepted HANDOFF without marking the aircraft checked in before its Strip asks for attention (ADR 0122, ours).
